However, many snippets simply describe surface-area (L^2) scaling of feeding under isomorphy without explicitly linking to transport-network morphology, and [9] notes empirical mismatches between predicted network geometry and observed scaling. Overall the relevant evidence consistently supports a morphology/network dependence of resource-uptake scaling, but support is moderate rather than strongly multi-sourced for feeding rate specifically (much is framed around metabolic rate).
